reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the limitation of Cr- and V-rich precipitates in the baseline W-Ta-Cr-V alloy by proposing a specific Hf addition, with a physically sound mechanism (lattice distortion, grain boundary stabilization) supported by cited evidence from the same alloy system, and a clear, testable falsification experiment.
